digest.component_or_area: CLI confirmation and mutation verb infrastructure
propositions: Structural assertions on the shared confirmation reduce-path (via seam-spy on _confirm.emit/emit_text) must verify that each verb routes exactly one line through the shared seam and that stdout contains only that line plus newline, catching regressions that bypass the shared seam.

Verb inventory (no-op-capable vs always-writes classification for all mutation verbs) must be recorded in a durable, reviewable location with CI drift-gating that fails if an unclassified verb is added to _CONFIRM_SCOPE.

Old-to-new confirmation-line mapping (pre-42cd70b889 behavior versus current behavior) must be recorded as golden data, capturing per-verb output changes including the transition CLOSE-only UNBLOCKED behavior.

The generated docs/cli-reference.md must render verb inventory and confirmation-line mapping tables from curated data in scripts/gen_cli_reference.py, with linting and type-checking passing and tests enforcing consistency between curated data and source verb definitions.
